text: {"lessons":["Recent price moves have not reliably predicted what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations.","Holding through market swings has not removed risk; I should make sure my positions fit my overall risk tolerance and time horizon.","Selling some Stock A after a large gain changed my exposure, but its average cost is not a reason by itself to sell or hold; I should base trades on a deliberate plan."]}
